A '''settlement''' was located at the upper levels of a canyon on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the settlement was attacked by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and was abandoned as a result, save for a few [[Droid/Legends|droids]] still remaining.
